content:
This one will work and
the provider is down
or blanched and
we agreed on approaches and
I've filled in what's necessary and
we can begin without an end.
It's hard to say what people want and
I can taste chicory again and
we're almost done and
I am thinking about you again. Don't
touch that. (Ok, it's going.) Let's
wrap arms. Make
this happen. That's
the idea.

The woman who
scrunched up her face when
you couldn't figure how
to get into the carpark and
the hatch or tail of
a car at a standstill as
the front pushes the corner in
a slink wheeze, I mean a manoeuvre still and
moving. I'm not an aerophone and
I'll take this breath later and
the trauma of the hatch or
tail scrunches up its face, too.
This one will work.
title: Get starting

readme: Falling helplessly into the borders of a categorisation system.
title: Abyss abyssing
